review_type: Separate role/scenario review; no application repair

findings.title: Scheduled attendance ingestion still uses a mock Kent connector
findings.evidence: Source-confirmed; real Kent was not contacted.
findings.acceptance_required: Obtain authorized Kent protocol, select a real adapter with explicit environment configuration, preserve raw identity/provenance and watermark/gap handling; prove recorded and real delayed/reconnect cases. Synthetic swipes cannot be presented as actual employee punches.

findings.title: Scoped HR can override and read another unit employee attendance
findings.evidence: RF01=200 writes outside scope; RF07=200 reads the foreign synthetic day.
findings.acceptance_required: Apply central employee scope to read and write; same-unit works, foreign employee is denied, cross-entity reporting-tree permissions still work when legitimately granted.

findings.title: Locked correction reports success and a whitespace reason is accepted
findings.evidence: RF04=200 with five spaces; RF05=200 but locked status remains P. Source writes success audit regardless of affected rows.
findings.acceptance_required: Trim and validate reason, employee/day/month lock in stable order, require actual affected row, atomically commit correct before/after audit. Locked correction must return a domain error and no success audit.

findings.title: Marking Absent retains old overtime and penalty facts
findings.evidence: RF06: status A retains 120 OT minutes and penalty_flag=true.
findings.acceptance_required: Define/reconcile derived facts and approved obligations; never blindly erase immutable swipes/OT approval. Make day, muster, exception display and payroll eligibility agree; audit each correction.

findings.title: Shift-scheme mutation has no employee population check
findings.evidence: RF08 scoped HR successfully updates the foreign synthetic employee scheme.
findings.acceptance_required: Apply existing employee-scope check, active shift validation, audited atomic change and recomputation scheduling; block unsafe changes to closed facts. Prove a manager cannot change an unrelated employee.

findings.title: Month checklist can show future/incomplete manual attendance as ready
findings.evidence: RF16 future January 2027 checklist canLock=true for synthetic manual employee population with no January day rows; manager-approval policy is disabled. No lock was executed.
findings.acceptance_required: Validate closed time window, complete expected employee/date population, unresolved recomputations/leave/request facts and attestation revision. Payroll already rejects missing day rows later; catch the gap before irreversible attendance lock. Establish signed manager-precondition policy.

findings.title: Payroll console simulates computation, approval, finalization and export
findings.evidence: Source-confirmed: INITIAL_REVIEW_ITEMS, fixed June 2026 and local setCurrentRunStatus handlers; no backend action in those handlers.
findings.acceptance_required: Replace sample records and local success with selected real company/month/run API; actual register/reconciliation, server transitions, capability-gated actions and real downloadable artifacts. Empty/error cannot become invented payroll.

findings.title: Two different payroll users satisfy approval without mandatory HR Head sign-off
findings.evidence: RF14 self-approval is refused (generic HTTP500); RF15 a different payroll-only user approves HTTP200. No HR Head participated. Synthetic under_review fixture included a valid attendance-lock FK and explicit maker audit; this checks authorization, not a full computed run.
findings.acceptance_required: Represent distinct maker/checker duties through centrally configured capabilities and recorded evidence; no handler role-name hardcoding. Require independent authorized HR co-sign and payroll action against unchanged result revision; return useful safe domain errors. Existing maker-identity checks must remain.

findings.title: Payroll orchestration still lacks complete statutory/OT/debt/arrears source consumption
findings.owning_stage: Phase 2 Stages 2.1–2.6, one at a time
findings.evidence: Source reconfirmed: computeLockedRun supplies salary, attendance, variable inputs, arrears and hold; it does not wire full statutory/previous-employer/YTD/debt facts; approved OT deliberately blocks instead of being paid with a guessed rate.
findings.acceptance_required: Use signed effective policy facts and immutable source/consumption authority, lawful entity eligibility, complete salary segments, verified YTD and obligations. Prove repeated recompute/next run cannot double-pay or double-deduct; preserve fail-closed OT until correct integration. Money edits require full docs04/10, golden/property cases and human review.

findings.title: Candidate conversion is not one transaction and can create unusable employee identity/pay
findings.evidence: Source reconfirmed; earlier H14 native autocommit orphan evidence remains applicable. Conversion uses plain db calls, placeholder password hash, optional salary and empty component snapshot; no readiness/source-target scope/DOJ gate beyond converted status.
findings.acceptance_required: Atomic candidate lock/conversion, accepted version evidence, approved DOJ readiness, source/target masters/scope, allocator, real identity invitation/employee grant, valid salary snapshot, tasks, probation, audit/outbox. Failure/concurrent retry creates no orphan or duplicate. Do not invent missing CTC, DOB, manager or bank.

findings.title: Onboarding stakeholders lack task access and biometric verification lacks provider proof
findings.evidence: RF17 IT task-list HTTP403; task routes require lifecycle.onboard.convert. Existing verify service stamps completion without Kent adapter evidence; prior H10 native proof retained.
findings.acceptance_required: Scoped stakeholder tasks without HR conversion authority; only permitted owner can complete. Biometric registration needs actual authorized provider result + matching employee, not a success stamp. Configure task SLA/owner data and prove notifications/escalation execution.

findings.title: Lifecycle decisions are not fully connected to required approval/payment history
findings.owning_stage: Phase 3 Stages 3.1–3.3, one at a time
findings.evidence: Source reconfirmed: probation emits issued letter with null workflow/document, transfers stamp notified_at directly, separation/F&F directly mutate state. Prior financial fixture/payment and salary-boundary findings remain open.
findings.acceptance_required: Versioned domain↔workflow link; every actual required approver and delivery receipt; no future-effective early mutation; confirmation salary interval/breakup; clearances, settlement approval and acknowledged payment before paid/letters/alumni cascade. Native end-to-end HR Head/Finance journeys required.

findings.title: LOI approval/acceptance integration is incomplete and reporting infers incorrect offer outcomes
findings.owning_stage: Phase 3 Stage 3.1 bridge; Phase 4 ATS absorption
findings.evidence: RF18 no_show maps to Rejected LOI without rejection fact. RF19 no offer/loi/offer_loi catalog rows. Source: no ATS intake worker registration; recruitment UI claims nightly feed/report integration.
findings.acceptance_required: Capture authorized ATS source contract. Separately model draft/approval/issued/accepted/rejected/joined/no-show events using approved source fields; preserve offer version and CTC/probation approval. Do not treat no-show as rejection. Prove Initiator→Plant Head/GM→HR Head→CEO→issue, acceptance, idempotent handoff and R21 from actual events. Phase4 work is scheduled scope, not a newly introduced regression.

findings.title: HR export, absence and dashboard scope gaps remain
findings.owning_stage: Phase 1 Stages 1.6/1.7 and owning report stages
findings.evidence: Source reconfirmation of prior H07/H12/H13; R21 accepts scope but does not apply it. No new cross-company export was executed in this increment.
findings.acceptance_required: Same authorized population in list, count, tile and Excel; explicit candidate/company scope before employee conversion; preserve column masks, filter parity and audited exports. Repeat prior native cross-company probes as repair regressions.

findings.title: HR routing repair exists as API but has no dedicated recovery screen
findings.evidence: Source: hold-list/retry backend routes exist; no routing-holds/retry-routing caller in frontend. Prior native vacancy hold/retry evidence remains positive.
findings.acceptance_required: Show scoped waiting-for-HR queue, cause, hierarchy/chain repair and audited reasoned retry. Retry must never itself approve. Prove actual email delivery separately from queue insertion.

findings.title: Lifecycle HTTP/UI contract failures are masked by sample fallback data
findings.evidence: Source: onboarding catches list failure and fills sample candidates; separation does the same for empty/error data. Several caller paths do not match registered nested procedures. Payroll POST list works; equivalent GET gives404 (RF10/11), which is not itself a defect when POST is the declared contract.
findings.acceptance_required: Generated actual HTTP contract, typed DTO/date output and runtime permissions, real lookup IDs; no sample business records on errors. Exercise each role screen→API→DB→reload and exports.

findings.title: Release acceptance and other SOW families remain open
findings.evidence: Existing workplace, assets, KPI, deployment, SMTP/storage, real master, Kent/UAT and coverage findings are retained. They are not independently exhaustively rerun by the19 diagnostic observations.
findings.acceptance_required: Close existing audience/survey/policy/helpdesk/custody issues, signed decisions, real source reconciliation, role training, restore/scale evidence and full gates; claims/budgets remain sponsor-deferred. Do not relabel carried findings as newly tested or repaired.
